centralRule: The model may help understand, retrieve, compare, and explain. Locally validated knowledge owns exact instructions.

gates.name: frozen_tutor_v1_baseline_and_broad_product_gap_map
gates.note: 332-question library (274 directly curated or source-grounded, 58 labeled paraphrase augmentation) and a gap map that drove knowledge work: it identified 8 high-priority uncovered domains, which curated strategy cards then closed to 0.

gates.name: open_ended_question_contract_and_router
gates.note: 9 question kinds and 100+ domains across 14 groups. TestRunner proves open questions with no Tutor v1 enum match still route and answer, while the nasal fast path still matches.

gates.name: lawful_source_acquisition_and_review_pipeline
gates.note: PARTIAL. The typed source registry, nine review states, rights/handling classes, transcript-provenance fields, and the audiovisual-review gate are implemented and enforced: a source requiring audiovisual review cannot ground a trusted claim, and TestRunner proves that. NOT DONE: no network acquisition was performed, no YouTube or external source was ingested, and the ingest/extraction/review CLIs are not written. All current knowledge derives from reviewed artifacts already in the repository.

gates.name: general_production_knowledge_graph_and_retrieval
gates.note: 15 sources, 458 claims, 68 strategies, 12 concepts, 2 preserved contradictions, all provenance-linked to reviewed in-repo artifacts and SHA-256 verified at load. Retrieval is deterministic lexical ranking with typed domain/kind/source filters, per-source diversity caps, and contradiction-aware inclusion. Chosen over embeddings for determinism, locality, inspectability, and zero added dependency.

gates.name: grounded_answer_synthesis_and_exact_instruction_validation
gates.note: Versioned answer contract with strategy options, assumptions, tradeoffs, preservation, stop conditions, sources, and limitations. The validator rejects invented claim/source/concept/procedure IDs, uncited numeric recommendations, forbidden action or hearing claims, undisclosed material contradictions, personal results presented as universal, and overstated audio influence. All proven by adversarial TestRunner checks.

gates.name: adaptive_general_tutor_workflow_and_native_ui
gates.note: PARTIAL. Guide Me now takes any production question through an Ask action and renders the validated answer natively: interpreted kind and domains, confidence class, direct answer, disclosed assumptions, one recommended first move with listen-for and stop rule, ranked strategy cards with tradeoffs/preservation/stop rules, contradiction disclosures, collapsible preserve/risk/non-DSP/cannot-see detail, source list with evidence class, the audio-influence statement, and the teaching principle. A strategy option backed by a reviewed procedure offers "Start guided experiment", which hands off into the existing validated Tutor v1 step flow. Verified live in the signed build against the MIDI-timing acceptance question. NOT DONE: no Research This control, no memory controls, and no structured user-context entry beyond the existing chain reporter.

gates.name: personalization_and_confirmed_outcome_memory
gates.note: PARTIAL. PersonalOutcomeRecord is defined with explicit user-confirmation, and the answer validator rejects a personal result presented as universal. NOT DONE: no persistence, no profile store, no view/edit/forget/delete UI, and no ranking influence.

gates.name: broad_evaluation_adversarial_and_regression_evidence
gates.note: PARTIAL. 332/332 corpus cases pass across 89 domains and all 9 question kinds, with 20 adversarial cases and five general-tutor TestRunner checks; Tutor v1 (77/77) and all prior lanes remain green. NOT MET: the brief's 500-case and 100-multi-turn thresholds. Multi-turn general sequences are not implemented, and retrieval precision/recall cases with expected and forbidden card IDs are not written.

gates.name: real_project_and_direct_logic_validation
gates.note: Not started, and not startable without the owner. Requires 20 real production-question sessions on the owner's own work plus in-host validation of representative procedures. No owner session has been run in any milestone to date.

gates.name: closure_and_vocal_module_v1_handoff
gates.note: Blocked by GP5, GP7, and GP8.
